concerns.text: All functional requirements (FR‑001 … FR‑009) and success criteria (SC‑001 … SC‑006) are present in the specification.
All success criteria (SC‑001 … SC‑006) are present in the specification.
Tasks T001a (create directories) and T001b (create .gitkeep files) are not linked to any FR or SC in the spec.
Tasks T002a (add .flake8 config) and T002b (run ruff and black linting) have no explicit mapping to a functional requirement or success criterion.
Task T003 creates an empty checksums.json file, but the spec does not require an empty checksum manifest; this task is unreferenced by any FR/SC.
Task T004 populates requirements.txt and pyproject.toml, yet no functional requirement in the spec mandates a specific dependency file layout.
Tasks T006 (populate checksums) and T007 (validate checksums) are not explicitly covered by any FR or SC; the spec only mentions checksum hygiene in principle but not as a distinct requirement.
Tasks T040 (artifact checksums), T041 (README generation), and T042 (repo tagging) are not mapped to any FR or SC; they appear to be over‑reach beyond the listed requirements.
